card.name: Last digit of a dose before mg
card.fires_on: The final digit of a dose number, such as the 5 in 0.625 or 15, right before the unit mg is expected. It fires in drug-label dose statements.

modes.label: Decimal dose digit
modes.description: The last digit of a decimal strength, such as 0.625, just before mg.
modes.example: one maroon tablet containing 0.62<<5>> mg CE taken orally on days 1

modes.label: Whole-number dose digit
modes.description: A digit in an integer dose, with mg next.

modes.label: Digit before mg per area or volume
modes.description: A final digit followed by mg/m2 or mg per mL.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the unit mg next and away from spelled-out numbers like twenty or forty.
card.plain: It marks the end of a dose number, where the unit mg should come next.
